playerMetadata.pitch: Two blood-drained bodies revive the legend of Brannam's dead vampire tyrant. Investigate a collapsing city where the obvious monster may not be the killer, and where solving the murders may still leave something older beneath the streets.
playerMetadata.setting: Brannam, a decaying former trade city on the Aulach River

hard.rule: Victor Marlowe committed the initial murders of Marya Dolen and Harrin Velth. Edric did not.
Edric von Braech begins dormant in the Sealed Crypt until that location is breached.
Evelyn Marlowe died before the campaign; Victor exhumed her body and moved it to his Secret Laboratory.
The Flooded Shrine is the deeper alien/biological corrupting influence associated with the King Below.
Stopping Victor or Edric does not automatically restore Brannam or destroy the Flooded Shrine.
The Sacrificial Blood Rite can restore Brannam's prosperity trajectory only with recurring annual sacrifice and alien consequences for the ritual leader.
The surviving Blood Rite instructions are found in an intact book in the second-floor Library of Edric's Ruins.

conditional.rule: Breaching the Sealed Crypt wakes Edric in a weakened state.
If awakened and not immediately destroyed or contained, Edric seeks refuge in Saint Arlen's Catacombs and begins feeding to restore himself.
Destroying the Flooded Shrine ends its local influence but does not repair Brannam's material decay.

soft.rule: Minor residents, ordinary shops, street details and incidental dialogue may be improvised within each established district without changing named NPC knowledge or keyed clues.

freeImprovisation.rule: Players may pursue any plausible investigation, traversal, social or combat action. The AI resolves it against current campaign state rather than forcing scene order.

locations.name: Brannam
locations.description: Decaying former trade city and investigation hub.

locations.name: Brannam Sewers
locations.description: Six keyed sewer sectors connecting Victor's hidden routes, civic infrastructure and the Sealed Crypt.
secrets: King Below signs appear in older/deeper infrastructure.

locations.name: Victor's Secret Laboratory
locations.description: Victor's hidden blood-research site containing Evelyn's body, moved equipment and notes about the Voice from Below.
secrets: The Voice from Below influenced his work.

locations.name: Sealed Crypt of von Braech
locations.description: Edric's dormant resting place, exposed through erosion and collapse.

locations.name: Saint Arlen's Catacombs
locations.description: Three keyed levels descending from civic religion into older alien structures.
secrets: Edric uses the Catacombs as refuge after awakening if he survives.

locations.name: Ruins of Edric von Braech's Keep
locations.description: Two keyed ruin floors plus a sixteen-room secret dungeon preserving Edric's history and ritual knowledge.
secrets: The Blood Rite instructions are in the second-floor Library.

locations.name: Secret Dungeon beneath the Ruins
locations.description: Sixteen keyed rooms including The Forgotten's cell and the route toward the Shrine.
secrets: The Unused Cell contains a source-defined hidden-door mechanism.

locations.name: Flooded Shrine
locations.description: Flooded corridor and alien biological shrine tied to the King Below.
secrets: Its deeper purpose is not humanly comprehensible.

locations.name: Brannam Graveyard
locations.description: Contains the recent victims and Evelyn's secretly emptied grave.

npcs.privateGoal: Restore Evelyn through blood-based alchemy while rationalising the Voice from Below.
knowledge: his own experience of the Voice from Below

npcs.name: Edric von Braech
npcs.privateGoal: After awakening, survive, feed, regain power and reclaim Brannam.
knowledge: his experience with the Flooded Shrine
secrets: can become a regional threat if ignored

npcs.name: Father Brenwick
npcs.publicGoal: Protect frightened residents and the Chapel.

npcs.name: Feyra Lrowyn
knowledge: King Below / Flooded Shrine tale when appropriately prompted

factions.name: Edric's returning dominion
goals: Reclaim Brannam if he survives long enough

clocks.name: Brannam Collapse
clocks.advanceRule: Advance according to source murder totals and decay events rather than simply because scenes pass.

clocks.name: Edric's Return
clocks.advanceRule: Advance only after Edric awakens and successfully feeds.

scenes.title: A City Waiting to Die
requiredFacts: Marya Dolen and Harrin Velth were found blood-drained with puncture-like wounds.
Residents revive stories of Edric von Braech.
Victor is the true initial killer but that is hidden.
hiddenFacts: The Flooded Shrine is influencing Victor

choices.label: Find someone who knows Brannam's history

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Allow any plausible investigation or departure. Do not reveal Victor or the Shrine without earned evidence.

scenes.title: Overlapping Clues and Bad Explanations
requiredFacts: The investigation has multiple clue routes through residents, merchants, graves, Victor's sites, sewers and history.
hiddenFacts: Rumours may be false or partially true.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Route free-form investigation to the actual location/NPC implicated by the player's method. Missing one clue never rewrites campaign truth.

scenes.title: Victor Runs or Falls
requiredFacts: Victor can be captured or killed before reaching Edric.
If he flees successfully he tries to escape Brannam but may take the wrong route into the Sealed Crypt.
hiddenFacts: Entering the Sealed Crypt awakens Edric.

choices.label: Cut off the Ruined Outflow Passage
Try to capture him rather than kill him
Let him run and secure the evidence

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Do not force the source chase outcome. Victor may be stopped, escape Brannam, or wake Edric depending on actual play.

scenes.title: The Tyrant Wakes
requiredFacts: Edric wakes weakened, not fully restored.
If he survives he seeks refuge in the Catacombs and feeds to regain power.

choices.label: Investigate what else the Crypt reveals

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use current Edric state and authorised Shadowdark rules. Do not reset him to dormant after escape.

scenes.title: Below the Human Ruins
requiredFacts: The Shrine is the deeper alien influence.
Destroying it and restoring Brannam through the Blood Rite are materially different choices.
hiddenFacts: The Blood Rite demands recurring annual sacrifice and marks the ritual leader with alien consequences.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Preserve the moral and causal distinction between destroying influence, restoring prosperity through sacrifice, and leaving the Shrine intact.

endings.title: The Murders Stop, For Now
endings.summary: Victor's murder series ends; Edric may remain dormant and the Flooded Shrine remains unless separately confronted.

endings.title: The Old Tyrant Falls Again
endings.summary: Edric is destroyed, but Brannam remains decayed and the Flooded Shrine remains a separate unresolved cause unless addressed.

endings.title: The Influence Ends
endings.summary: The Shrine's local influence ends through a violent destruction sequence; Brannam is not magically restored to prosperity.

endings.title: Prosperity at a Price
endings.summary: Brannam can recover, but annual human sacrifice remains required and the ritual leader bears alien consequences.

endings.title: The Tyrant Returns
endings.summary: Edric restores himself, enslaves surviving Brannam residents and grows into a regional threat.

communityIntelligence.finding: No community report is allowed to change source canon; any future play reports are balance/pacing evidence only.
